text:
Theoretically you can apply online for it here: https://www.gov.il/en/service/inquiry_of_exit_and_entery_from_israel. But it might take some time, and also there could be problems because they are still registering your new ID number in the system. 

I would recommend going in person to get it - bring your passport and your sefach. You can get it by just going to the front registry counter (not the visa desk). No need for an appointment, and you don't need to go in at crazy hours either - any weekday when they are open. Takes one minute. Some offices have machines where you can try request it too, but in my experience these usually don't work.
